verdict.rationale: Adyen has a dedicated documentation-tools page aimed at AI tools. It covers an llms.txt that follows the proposed standard, raw markdown for most pages by appending `.md`, and a full offline docs mirror ZIP for giving context to AI agents. It also offers OpenAPI specs on GitHub as LLM context alongside its MCP server. Live probes confirm both that llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with structured content and that `.md` page rendering works.
